section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study conducted in Iran. A total of 1093 university students (568 men and 525 women) were recruited from seven universities in Tehran, with a mean age of 25.87 years and mean self-reported BMI of 23.69 kg/m². All participants were college-level students, representing 100% college or higher education.
